race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
race.verdict: BUTTERFLY BEACH hasn't been seen since disappointing on reappearance in May but starts out for a new yard here and if she gets back to her juvenile form she'll be tough to beat. Nando Tornado showed ability along with inexperience on debut here 12 days ago and can improve, while March of Time holds claims in a race lacking in depth. BUTTERFLY BEACH (IRE) NANDO TORNADO (IRE) MARCH OF TIME (IRE)
